recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes FHIR-52920 by aligning the implementer-facing warning text with the already-correct section-level expression and placement without changing the intended warning semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-52920 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 by Structured Documents. It requested a warning invariant on Composition.section so sections should contain section.text unless they consist only of sub-sections, narrowed by resolution to apply when Composition.attester exists using text.exists() or section.exists().
initial_application: Commit 160c286be6 initially added cmp-3 at the Composition root with an attester.empty() expression, and 0cb437f657 added pass/fail invariant fixtures. Commit 1c94be2020 then moved cmp-3 to Composition.section and changed the expression to %resource.attester.exists() implies(text.exists() or section.exists()) after Jira comments noted the lost %resource prefix and wrong root placement. The remaining problem was stale human text that still described the Composition itself needing text or a section.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Composition as an active resource, so source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml is current build source. The current source already had cmp-3 as a warning on Composition.section, condition references on Composition.attester and Composition.section, and cmp-3 invariant fixtures. FHIR-50934 is related background about signature canonicalization and excluding Narrative elements such as Composition.section.text, but it is a separate signatures/JSON issue and does not supersede this section warning. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting FHIR-52920 community evidence.
reconciliation: Changed only the cmp-3 human text in source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml to say that, when the Composition has attesters, each section should contain text or sub-sections. The FHIRPath expression, warning severity, Composition.section placement, and fixtures were preserved.
source_changes: source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml: updated cmp-3 human text from a root-level Composition wording to a section-level warning: if the Composition has attesters, each section should contain text or sub-sections.
